title: Neo Geo sound program (Z80)
description: An M-ROM (or a .neo file's sound program): the Z80's fixed first 32 KB as one block at 0 from its reset and interrupt entries, the sound ports by name; the banks after it are not written. Written as <name>.m1.asm in sjasmplus.
